shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\n-- config --\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml && printf '\\n-- files --\\n' && rg --files | rg '(chatOrchestrator|acceptance\\.test|\\.test\\.ts"'$|package.json$|reanchor)'"' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,320p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && rg -n \"afterModelResponse|UsageMetadata|usage:\" src | head -120 && sed -n '1,220p' src/types/ai.ts && cat package.json && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '430,570p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && rg -n \"specs/.*#|@spec|spec:\" src/*.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -80 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && ls .lore"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" src scripts | head -60; rg -n \"VALIDATED_BY|SPEC\" src/*.test.ts src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -60; sed -n '1,100p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.test.ts; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/|spec:\" --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs; rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -20"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '45,100p' && git diff --check && git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git commit -m "test usage across tool rounds" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
